title: Code, data and results for: How reliable are machine-learning models of biofilters? Validation leakage, naive baselines and physics-based alternatives for VOC and H2S biofiltration
description: Jupyter/Kaggle notebook, cleaned Dataset A and all result tables and figures for the paper submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software. The notebook reproduces every number, table and figure from two public biofiltration datasets. Version 1.2.1 places all outputs in results/; version 1.2 added statistical forecast benchmarks, constrained and physics-informed learners, split-conformal prediction intervals and a simulation study (notebook Part E).
